Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities,

to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the

IS : 10653 - 1983 




Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2001 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
HUB AXLE, REAR FOR MOPEDS 



1. Scope — Covers requirements for rear hub axle for mopeds. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — Shall be as given in the Figure. The threads shall conform to IS : 4218 
( Part 2 )-1976 ' ISO metric screw threads Part 2 Diameter-pitch combinations {first revision ) \ If an 
additional centre hole is drilled it shall conform to IS : 2473-1975 ' Dimensions for centre holes ( first 
revision ) '.

CENTRE HOLE OPTIONAL 



Note — T may vary to suit the requirements. The ends may also be rounded off. 

3. Material — The material used for manufacturing hub axles shall conform to the following: 

40 CrlMo 28 of Schedule IV of (5:1570-1961 'Schedules for wrought steels for general 
engineering purposes '. 

If any material other than the above is used, it shall be suitably heat treated, to achieve physical 
properties equivalent to the above material. 

4. Hardness — Hardness of the axle shall be at least 250 HV ( 22 H/?C ). If heat treated, the hardness 
shall not exceed 285 iHV ( 28 HRC ). 

5. Finish — The axle shall have a smooth finish and shall be chemically treated or zinc plated to service 
condition No. 2 of IS : 1573-1970 'Specification for electroplated coatings of zinc on iron and steel 
( first revision ) \ 

The straightness and concentricity shall be within 0025 mm and 01 mm, respectively. 

6. Packing — Axles shall be packed in cartons after wrapping in oil coated paper, so as to prevent any 
damages. 

7. Marking —Manufacturers' trade-mark or name and size designation shall be embossed or punched 
on the axles. Any other marking as per best prevalent trade practice may also be followed. 

7.1 iSI Certification IVIarl^ing — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution, 

8. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed upon between a supplier and purchaser, the inspection 
sampling shall be as per IS : 2500 ( Part 1 )-1973 ' Sampling Inspection tables: Part 1 Inspection by 
attributes;;and by count of defects ( first revision ) '. 



Adopted 23 September 1983
